We need to produce mapped_rxn and template_id for the retrosynthetic step that matches the description: substitution of hydroxyl with halogen (C-O bond broken, C-Halogen formed). The target molecule is not directly given in the prompt, but we have previous step: make_6_lvl2-apply_template-2 gave precursors list: [["COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1", "C[NH+]4CC(F)C4"]]. That seems to be the result of applying a template to some target molecule. Now we need to return the mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule below (provided as available input data), reproduces the reaction. The "molecule below" is not explicitly shown, but likely the target molecule is the product of that previous step. The previous step gave precursors; the template applied to target gave those precursors. So we need to find the template that when applied to the target yields those precursors. We need to retrieve template info.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken: aliphatic hydroxyl? The forward reaction breaks C-O bond (hydroxyl) and forms C-halogen. So broken functional group: aliphatic hydroxyl. Formed functional group: aliphatic halide? Let's get list of functional groups. Use get_available_functional_groups.
We will call get_available_functional_groups.
